description: The collection of information necessary to construct the alphas table in Nuclear Data Sheets.

alphas.description: The collection of alphas which will be displayed in the alphas table in Nuclear Data Sheets.  If an alpha has a 'finalLevel' property, it is a placed alpha and will be associated with the level at the indicated index in the levels table.  Otherwise, it is an unplaced alpha.

normalization.description: The normalization factor for alpha intensities.
